comparison.objective: Finish and clear four insert tangs; record levels and pins a hazardous platform before loading blocks.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate stabilizes a narrow mandrel while hammering; record supports a pivoting platform, aligns a pin through three holes, then places loads safely.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures and contained fragments without coil/shell damage; record requires a locked, level platform, two placed blocks, clear arms, and no hand contact. Candidate quantitative damage limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Although both include axial alignment, the record tests safeguard restoration and load sequencing, not fracture or debris control.
